article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Here is the plan to kick-start TheGuild, a project outlined in the previous article.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Layer 2 (L2): A 'helper' blockchain that sits on top of Ethereum, bundling transactions to make them faster and cheaper — while still relying on Ethereum for security.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: MetaMask: An easy-to-use crypto wallet (browser extension and mobile app) that lets you manage Ethereum accounts, tokens, and interact with decentralized apps — while keeping your private keys safe on your device.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Step 0: Gather first participants in a Discord, discuss principles and plan. Step 1: Build the V0 — the Guild Genesis — basic on-chain badges on an L2 testnet. Step 2: Start adding features to the V0 that we deem useful before L2-mainnet launch. Step 2: Ask for grants to an EVM L2 to finance mainnet launch. Step 3: Add features using web3 techs with contribution tokens, generating certifications along the way.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: We create a Dapp where users can create a profile and then give badges to other users. Badges should be reused when possible or created when non-existent.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: We want to rely on existing infrastructures and we will therefore use attest.org.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: We want to be GDPR friendly and we will therefore store personal information in a centralized back-end database for now.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: The V0 should be an MVP up and running as soon as possible, so we start simple and improve later.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: From there we will propose improvements to make the system more aligned with code standards (V0.1, V0.2 etc). During this phase we will issue badges to initial members and contributors.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Features considered V1+ are those requiring external funding: sponsored gas fees, expensive AWS infrastructure, and similar costs.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: A smart contract suite deployed on an L2 test network. The idea is to create badges and send them to other users identified by their address.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Anybody can create a badge. Badges should be reused when possible, and must have a description and a unique name.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: We will create a smart contract, TheGuildBadgeRegistry, containing a list of badges with unique non-duplicate names.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Users will create attestations of badges for others. Attestations can include optional justification text or project links.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: We will use EAS’ existing contracts. First we register our schema ('bytes32 badgeName, bytes32 justification'), then use the SDK in the frontend to create attestations referencing the schema ID, badge name, and justification.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: We can use an EAS Resolver contract to prevent duplicate badges and reward attestations with Activity Token.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: A full-stack DApp with frontend and backend plus a database. The frontend is minimalist, with profiles, search, profile editing, and badge-giving. All actions require MetaMask.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: The backend stores personal information that should not be on-chain: name, description, and profile picture. Authentication is done via MetaMask signed messages for each API call.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Is the Guild a DAO? Ultimately yes. The goal is to create a Decentralized Autonomous Organization, but we don’t need an on-chain DAO yet.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: The Guild will evolve into a full DAO. For now, governance can be prototyped using Discord and Snapshot to stay lightweight and flexible.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: There will be an Activity Token to track activity in the certification system and possibly Discord/voting participation, and a Contribution Token to reward community-built features and content.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Neither token should ever have monetary value. Their purpose is strictly governance — voting and decision-making in the Guild.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: During the kickstart phase, votes will be consultative and contribution tokens will hold significant weight.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Infrastructure: domain, ENS, deployment, fees. Community: events, merch, campaigns. Growth: ad campaigns, onboarding.

article: The Guild — roadmap and execution plan
text: Activity token on each attestation; gasless payments via Biconomy; keyless wallets with Fireblocks or Privy; backend infra to migrate badges across L2s; badge hierarchy via pointers; social account connections; batched transactions for multiple badges; institutional issuers; decentralized data layer; on-chain DAO; technical training.
